description:
Support us on Patreon: http://www.patreon.com/littlelightstudios/
Why do people love horror films? Are there any negative affects on the human mind from being entertained by dark and violent horror movies? We have a special guess Mia Pile a certified Mental Health First Aid Instructor and former Life Alignment Depression Program Facilitator for the Wildwood Lifestyle Center. Find out on this episode of LED Live.
#Scary #Movies #psychology
